what: Clicking an empty spot on the board sticks a sticker there, tilted randomly −24°~24°, snapping on from .6x (.35s back.out(2), 330px on wide screens, 66px on narrow, max 12 — beyond that the oldest ones fall off). Dragging while pressed stretches it by .25 of the hand movement, and past 140px of pull it detaches and follows the hand, if released before that, it snaps back into place like a rubber band (.55s elastic.out(1,.55))

options.size: Sticker size on wide screens (px), default 330

note: Sticker art paints star, circle, pill and four-petal shapes in four skin colors (--kf-accent·accent-soft·accent-text·ink). The original is a company illustration sticker set. Dragging is mouse only, and touch only sticks them so scrolling isn’t blocked

from.where: shared.js footer (original footer stickers: 330px, 66px on mobile, rotation −24 + 48 · rand · max 12 · snapping past a 140px pull · elastic.out(1,.55) .55s)
